claim: The three organism dependencyGates (equipe→ds.member-card, formulaire→ds.field, header→ds.nav-item) are blocked, and all three pin `expectedFigmaFileVersion: 2381568261081914456` while the campaign now runs on `2381581871281042338` — a stale-pin drift already visible by reading audit-campaign.json (research.md D9's 'already-acquired-by-reading' note).
verdictNote: The stale pin is REAL and reproduces on all three gates exactly as the prior reading found — but it does NOT fully explain the blockage, only PART of it. Each gate carries a SECOND, independent reason ahead of the version drift in its own `reasons` list: the dependency's OWN visual-campaign receipt (specs/011-fix-molecule-convergence/proofs/visual/result.json, `visual-campaign-v1` schema — a DIFFERENT, older measurement system than this feature's two instruments) already records `receipt-verdict-blocked`/`receipt-verdict-fail` for ds.member-card/ds.field/ds.nav-item, and the tool marks that receipt `probative: true` — meaning the block does not hinge on the version mismatch alone. Re-pinning `expectedFigmaFileVersion` to the current campaign version would remove ONE reason from each gate's list but would NOT, by itself, flip `open` to true while the underlying dependency verdict stays blocked/fail. Cross-reference: this feature's OWN, newer measurement of ds.member-card (visual-parity, 014/T030 — 52.52% raw, image-boundary) and ds.field (1.84%/2.20% raw, engine) corroborates that these dependencies are genuinely still divergent today, independent of which Figma version is pinned. Per FR-013/US5 scenario 3, this finding is CONSIGNED as an entry for 016 (the stale pin is a canvas-source-adjacent bookkeeping fact, and the underlying divergences are exactly the kind of governed-geometry/source work 015/016 exist for) — none of the three blockages is lifted here.
